screensaver.name: longafterdark

string._label: Module (an id from longafterdark --list; empty: all in turn)

screensaver._description:
The original After Dark screen savers of the 1990s (Flying Toasters, Fish, The Simpsons, Star Trek and more) and LucasArts' Star Wars Screen Entertainment: their own modules, run unchanged by Long After Dark's x86 emulator under Wine. Import your releases first (longafterdark --import). It shows every imported module in turn, or only the one whose id you give under Module (longafterdark --list shows the ids).
The Resolution applies to After Dark modules; Star Wars and Star Trek modules always draw at 640x480, keeping their shape. Only the primary monitor plays sound, and the preview is always silent. XScreenSaver ends it on any key or mouse move, so the modules' Caps Lock games are played in longafterdark's own full-screen mode.
